ཡང: also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
ངོ་སྤྲད: pointing out, face-introduction (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod 'point out')
ཀྱང: also, even, though (the form of yang after g, d, b, s)
བག་ཆགས: habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
ཕྱིར: outside, outward(?). The reading is uncertain; another print has dri med, 'stainless', here · here plainly 'out, outward' (phyi 'outside' + -r): phyir log 'turn back out', phyir thon 'come out' · back: phyir mi ldog go 'does not turn back' (phyir 'back' + ldog 'turn') · because, for the sake of (de'i phyir 'therefore', ci'i phyir 'why'; yod pa'i phyir 'because there is')
ཁྲིད: guidance, a lama's step-by-step instruction in practice · to lead, guide (khrid, past and imperative stem of 'khrid 'to lead')
དེ: that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
དངངས་སྐྲག: dread and terror (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'dread', + skrag 'be frightened')
སྐྱེས: arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
ནས: from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
བྲོས་པས: because it has fled (bros pa, past of 'bros 'run away', + -s)
ཡི་དམ་དུ: as the yidam (yi dam 'one's chosen deity' + -du 'as, to')
ངོ: face; the nature or identity of a thing
མ: not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!' · mother (ma): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
ཤེས: to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
ཏེ: and, and so: links a verb to what follows (te, the form of ste after n, r, l; this print also writes it after other letters)
འཕྲོད་པ: meeting, recognition ('phrod 'to meet' + -pa): ngo 'phrod pa 'the recognition'
ལ: to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …') · from, of, with verbs of fleeing and fearing (X la bros 'flee from X')
ཁྲག་འཐུང: blood-drinker, blood-drinking: the name of the wrathful deities (khrag 'blood' + 'thung, the present stem of 'to drink', past 'thungs; Sanskrit heruka)
ལས: from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
ཀྱི: of (the form used after d, b, s; also gyi, gi, -'i, yi) · in this print perhaps also written where kyis 'by' is meant (khyod kyi gong du, read as khyod kyis)
དང: and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
རྣམས: plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
བསུ་བ: meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
འོང: comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
སྟེ: and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
ངོ་སྤྲད་པ: pointed out, the pointing out (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod, + pa)
ནི: as for: marks the topic of the sentence
ཚེ་འདས: one whose life has passed, the dead person (tshe 'life' + 'das 'gone beyond')
བོད: will call, to call (bod, the future stem of 'bod 'to call')
འདི་སྐད་དོ: these words (are said) ('di 'this' + skad 'speech' + the sentence-ending -do)
ཀྱེ: O! (kye, a word of calling; the print's other spelling of kyai)
རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས: the Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan 'das, Sanskrit bhagavān; 'das 'gone beyond')
ཞེས: so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)

བགྲད་པ: spread wide, set apart (bgrad + -pa); said of legs planted in a wide stance
ན: if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
ཁ་ཊྭཾ་ག: khaṭvāṅga, the staff topped with skulls (Sanskrit khaṭvāṅga, written in three syllables, kha TwaM ga; also written khaTwaM ga)
ཐ་མ: lowest, last (tha ma): tha ma'i yang tha ma 'the lowest even of the lowest'
གྱི: of (the form used after n, m, r, l)
ཡུམ: mother; a buddha's female partner, consort (yum)
གཡས་པས: with the right (hand) (g.yas pa 'the right one' + -s 'by, with')
ཡབ: father (yab, respectful); the male of a buddha and his consort
གཡོན་པས: with the left (hand) (g.yon pa 'the left one' + -s 'by, with')
ཞལ་དུ: to the mouth, to the face (zhal 'face, mouth', the respectful word, + -du 'to')
སྟོབ་པ: perhaps giving to eat, feeding (stob + -pa; the sense is not sure)
ཡབ་ཡུམ: father and mother; a buddha and his consort in union (yab 'father' + yum 'mother')
གི: of (the form used after g, ng); in this print also written where gis 'by' is meant · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows ('ong gi 'comes, and')
འཇིགས་ཤིག: be afraid! ('jigs 'fear' + shig, which marks a command); ma 'jigs shig 'do not be afraid'
སྐྲག་ཅིག: be frightened! (skrag + cig, which marks a command); ma skrag cig 'do not be frightened'
དངངས་ཤིག: be terrified! (dngangs + shig, which marks a command); ma dngangs shig 'do not be terrified'
སྐུར: as the body, in the body of (sku 'body' + -r 'as, in')
གྱིས་ཤིག: do! (gyis, imperative of byed 'do', + shig, which marks a command)
དོན: meaning, point, matter; a heading or part of a text
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པ: Amoghasiddhi, 'He Whose Aim Is Accomplished' (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished'): the buddha of the north and of the fifth day
གྲོལ་བ: being freed, liberation (grol + ba, which makes a verb into a noun)
བསྒྲགས་པས: by proclaiming, because it is proclaimed (bsgrags, past stem of sgrog 'to proclaim, cry aloud' (sgrog / bsgrags / bsgrag / sgrogs) + -pa + -s 'by, because')
གཉིས་སུ: into two, as two (gnyis 'two' + -su): gnyis su med par 'without being two, non-dually'
སངས་རྒྱས་པར: to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
དག: pure, correct · plural marker after de: de dag 'those, these' · plural marker after nouns too: sgom chen dag 'great meditators', gzhan dag 'others'
གདམས་ངག: instruction, a lama's oral advice (gdams 'instruct' + ngag 'speech')
རང་སྣང: self-appearance, one's own appearance (rang 'self' + snang 'appear'): what the mind itself shows
ཤེས་པས: because of knowing (shes pa 'knowing' + -s 'because'): ma shes pas 'because you did not know'
གྲོལ་ལོ: is freed, was freed (grol 'be freed' + the sentence-ending -lo)
འདི་ལྟར: in this way, like this ('di 'this' + ltar 'like')
མི: not (before present and future verbs) · person, human being (mi): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has known'
གཅིག: one; a, a certain · perhaps 'together, at once' (as gcig 'one' in 'od drug kyang gcig 'char du 'ong 'the six lights also dawn together'); the sense is not sure
གིས: by (the form used after g, ng) · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows, as gi does ('ong gis 'comes, and')
ངོ་སྤྲད་པས: by being pointed out (ngo sprad 'point out' + -pa + -s 'by')
འདིར: here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
རིག་པ: knowing, awareness itself, before any thought
ནམ་མཁའི: of the sky, of space (nam mkha' + -'i 'of')
ཁམས: realm, world, element (khams): 'jig rten gyi khams 'the realms of the world'
ངོ་སྤྲོད: to point out, to introduce: to bring someone face to face with a thing so that he recognises it (ngo 'face' + sprod 'bring together')
མ་ཐག་ཏུ: as soon as, immediately after (ma 'not' + thag 'distance' + -tu: 'with no interval'): after a verb
འོད་གསལ: clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
ཤར་བའི: of what dawned, that dawned (shar, the past stem of 'char 'dawn', + -ba + -'i 'of')
མ་བུ: mother and child (ma 'mother' + bu 'child'); in this teaching, the clear light of reality ('mother') and the clear light known in practice ('child')
འཕྲད: to meet, to come upon ('phrad): X dang 'phrad 'to meet with X'
རང་ཤར: arisen of itself, self-arisen (rang 'self' + shar, past of 'char 'arise')
འདྲིས: familiar, familiarity ('dris): sngar 'dris med pa 'without earlier familiarity'
རང་རིག: self-knowing, awareness aware of itself (rang 'self' + rig 'know')
ཉམས: decline, wane, be damaged (nyams); of a vow, 'broken'
འཁོར་བར: in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
ནང: inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'
འཆར་དུ: to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
ཡེངས་པར: distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
ཉོན་ཅིག: listen! (nyon, imperative of nyan 'listen', + cig, which marks a command)
ཤར: arisen, appeared (shar, past of 'char 'arise') · the east (shar): dkyil 'khor de'i shar nas 'from the east of that maṇḍala'
ཞིང: and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing) · realm, field; a buddha-field (zhing, short for zhing khams): dag pa'i zhing 'pure realm'
བྷན་དྷ: skull-cup, vessel (Sanskrit bhāṇḍa 'vessel', in Tibetan letters)
རྡོ་རྗེ: vajra, the diamond-thunderbolt held by deities, emblem of what cannot be broken (rdo rje)
གྱིས: do! (imperative of byed 'to do'); spelled the same as gyis 'by' · by (the 'by' ending as a free word after n, m, r, l): las bzang ngan gyis 'by good or bad karma'
བཟུང: held, seized (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold': 'dzin / bzung / gzung / zung): bzung yang ma zin pa 'held, yet not caught'
ཅིང: and, while (links two verbs; also shing, zhing)
ཉམས་པའི: of the broken, that is spoiled (nyams pa 'to be damaged, to lapse' + -'i 'of'): dam tshig nyams pa'i 'whose commitments are broken'
གནས: to remain, to stay; a place · state, condition (gnas bsgyur 'changed in state')
བསྐོར: surrounded, encircled (bskor, past of skor 'to surround, to circle')
བལྟ: to look (blta, future stem of lta 'look'): blta mi bzod pa 'unbearable to look at'
ཤིང: and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
ཀྱཻ: O! a call for attention (also written kye)
ལྕགས་ཀྱུ་མ: Iron-Hook Lady (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the hook she holds
ཤར་དུ: to arise, to dawn (shar, past of 'char 'arise', + -du 'to'): shar du 'ong 'will arise'
འཛིན་པ: grasping, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa): the mind taking hold of what it sees · holding with compassion (thugs rjes 'dzin pa)
དྲག་པོའི: of the fierce, of the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -'i 'of')
ཕྱི་རིམ་དུ: in the outer tier, on the outer ring (phyi 'outer' + rim 'tier, ring' + -du 'in')
སྣ་ཚོགས: various, of many kinds (sna tshogs): gar sna tshogs 'dances of many kinds'
བཅས་ཏེ: together with (bcas + te; dang bcas te: 'along with')
འགག: narrow pass, crucial point, critical moment ('gag); set phrase 'gag la thug pa
ཐུགས་པའི: uncertain; as printed, with thugs 'mind' (respectful), no sense; read, as a guess, as thug pa'i 'of reaching' (thug 'reach, meet' + -pa'i 'of')
པདྨ: lotus (Sanskrit padma, written with stacked letters; said 'pema'). Here the Lotus family, the deities grouped around Amitābha · the flower itself, as an emblem held in the hand: phyag na padma bsnams pa 'holding a lotus in the hand'
ཏྲི་ཤུལ: trident (Sanskrit triśūla, in a Tibetan spelling)
འཁོར་ལོ: wheel ('khor lo); the wheel of the teaching
